summary: Completed iteration 2 regression testing: all six backend tests passed, public OpenAPI is valid JSON, requester authorization is isolated, disabled integration contracts are explicit, and admin/requester/mobile UI flows passed.
action_items: Keep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported when running backend regression tests; the existing runtime test intentionally fails at collection if it is absent.
critical_code_review_comments: Real Teams, AI, and voice integrations remain disabled and are clearly represented as not_configured/disabled as required.
seed_data_creation: Regression created TEST requester and UI tickets/comments; no production seed records were modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth, requester isolation, admin/agent ticket access, OpenAPI, Teams card, AI, voice, desktop admin flow, mobile menu, and requester portal were covered. Requester portal had no visible seeded rows during UI run, though API-owned request creation/viewing passed.
rca of the issue: The initial test command omitted REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from the shell, causing test_runtime_phase1.py collection failure; rerunning with frontend/.env URL passed all tests. Desktop mobile-menu attempt was invalid because CSS correctly hides that control above 900px; dedicated 390px run passed.
